note: Benchmark candidate pools per kind, enumerated by candidate_rules.py at the repository root (the only implementation; detector builds copy it unchanged). Both kinds are declared explicitly; a detector no longer supplies the rule. The rule fields and the module's SHA-256 enter the table provenance (new table directories). Changing an entry changes the rows and invalidates feature tables, availability sidecars, companions and context caches of that kind for every brain; pool_sha256 hashes the rows only, so a module edit that keeps them leaves companions and context caches valid. Evidence numbers are reported, not gates.
